title: An etale ring map realizes a prescribed finite separable residue field extension at a prime
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=R_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and let $L$ be a field extension of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-pc-field-extension], with structure map $\iota:\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to L$, which is finite ($\dim_{\kappa(\mathfrak p)}L<\infty$) and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then there are a homomorphism of commutative rings $\psi:R\to R'$ such that the induced morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\psi:\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] (equivalently, $\psi$ is an etale ring map in the sense of Stacks, Algebra, Definition 00U1), a prime ideal $\mathfrak p'\subset R'$ with $\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')=\mathfrak p$, and a field isomorphism $\lambda:\kappa(\mathfrak p')\to L$ such that $\lambda\circ\kappa(\psi)=\iota$, where $\kappa(\psi):\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ is the field homomorphism induced by $\psi$ ($r/t\bmod\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}\mapsto\psi(r)/\psi(t)\bmod\mathfrak p'R'_{\mathfrak p'}$).
